historical_record.description: The Art Commission approved the final working drawings, with landscaping by the designers named, for the St. Mary's Square Garage, designed by Eckbo, Royston and Williams, Landscape Architects.

The permanent bronze grille and structure of the Chinese-American War Memorial, honoring servicemen of Chinese ancestry killed in the two World Wars, was dedicated in St. Mary's Square on Memorial Day, with ceremonies the Recreation and Park Commission had approved in March.
The Recreation and Park Commission approved an accessible public toilet at St. Mary's Square, maintained under the city's J. C. Decaux contract, with its advertising kiosks kept off park property.
Beniamino Bufano's statue of Sun Yat-sen in St. Mary's Square was dedicated on the afternoon of November 12, 1937, and Acting President Henry F. Budde accepted it on behalf of the Park Commission.
